name: Active Scanning
desc: Scan in-scope hosts for open ports/services.
emulation: Enumerate authorized targets (ports/services/banners) — read-only.
detection: IDS port-scan signatures; spikes in connection attempts.

name: Scanning IP Blocks
desc: Sweep authorized IP ranges for live hosts.
emulation: Live-host sweep of authorized CIDRs — read-only.

name: Vulnerability Scanning
desc: Scan in-scope assets for known vulns.
emulation: Non-exploitative vuln scan of authorized assets.

name: Gather Victim Host Information
emulation: Fingerprint OS/software from authorized banners/headers.

name: Gather Victim Identity Information
desc: Collect emails/usernames for the in-scope org.
emulation: OSINT username/email enumeration on authorized domains.

name: Gather Victim Network Information
desc: Map the in-scope org's network footprint.
emulation: Passive ASN/DNS/subdomain mapping of authorized assets.
detection: Passive recon is hard to detect.

name: Gather Victim Org Information
emulation: OSINT org/role/tech-stack collection for in-scope org.

name: Phishing for Information
emulation: Authorized pretext info-gathering to consented contacts only.

name: Search Open Technical Databases
emulation: Query open tech databases for in-scope assets — read-only.

name: Search Open Websites/Domains
emulation: Review the authorized org's public web/social footprint.

name: Search Victim-Owned Websites
desc: Crawl the org's own sites for data.
emulation: Crawl authorized public site for metadata/paths — read-only.

name: Acquire Infrastructure
emulation: Planning-only: document required infra; no target action.

name: Compromise Accounts
emulation: Planning-only: note credential sources; no real compromise.

name: Stage Capabilities

emulation: Confirm exposed remote services and test provided test creds.

name: Supply Chain Compromise
emulation: Audit in-scope dependency/build trust — read-only; do not tamper.

name: Drive-by Compromise
emulation: Verify a watering-hole vector exists; do not weaponize.

name: Hardware Additions
